newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra develops new pain killer - paper.
newsitem.headline: Astra develops new pain killer - paper.

text.p: Drugs company Astra AB could launch a pain killer made from body cells within the next three years, Swedish business daily Finanstidningen said on Tuesday.
"The project is going according to plan and is developing in a promising way," Astra's head of information Staffan Ternby was quoted as saying.
"Recently we have reached phase II and if nothing goes wrong, we expect to have the drug on the market in three years."
The market potential is large, the newspaper said.
"If we succeed in finalising the project, then it is not a risky guess to say that the drug can reach annual sales of around one billion crowns in ten years," Ternby was quoted as saying.
